items.summary: Veteran-led nonprofit Team Rubicon stood up its first Hurricane Isaias disaster relief operation: up to 30 Greyshirts per day from Tue Oct 13 in Milton and across Santa Rosa County for debris management, roof tarping, heavy equipment and sawyer work. Its route-clearance team removed 54 obstructions over the weekend and cut paths for power crews across Santa Rosa County; op runs through at least Oct 21, with a Pensacola op expected soon.
items.title: Team Rubicon launches Isaias relief operation in Santa Rosa County
